properties.name: Bagbazar Sarbojanin
properties.highlight: One of the oldest sarbojanin pujas. Traditional daker saaj idol, plus a riverside fair.

properties.name: Kumartuli Park Sarbojanin
properties.highlight: Next door to the idol-makers' quarter. Expect bold, artistic themes every year.

properties.name: Kumartuli Sarbojanin
properties.highlight: Worshipped where the idols are born. Walk the artisan lanes on the way.

properties.name: Ahiritola Sarbojanin
properties.highlight: A riverside neighbourhood puja known for large-scale theme work.

properties.name: Ahiritola Jubak Brinda
properties.highlight: A short hop from Ahiritola Sarbojanin, with inventive craft themes.

properties.name: Sovabazar Rajbari
properties.highlight: A bonedi bari puja started by Raja Nabakrishna Deb. The thakurdalan is stunning.

properties.name: Kashi Bose Lane
properties.highlight: A lane-side puja that keeps winning art awards.

properties.name: Nalin Sarkar Street
properties.highlight: A famous Hatibagan theme puja tucked into a narrow lane.

properties.name: Hatibagan Sarbojanin
properties.highlight: Right at the Hatibagan crossing. Easy to combine with street shopping.

properties.name: Hatibagan Nabin Pally
properties.highlight: A smaller theme puja a few minutes from the Hatibagan crossing.

properties.name: Jagat Mukherjee Park
properties.highlight: Park-based theme puja near Shyambazar.

properties.name: Tala Prattoy
properties.highlight: North Kolkata's blockbuster theme puja. The queue moves fast at dawn.

properties.name: Mohammad Ali Park
properties.highlight: A Central Avenue giant known for lavish replicas and theme pandals.

properties.name: Chaltabagan Lohapatty
properties.highlight: Theme puja off Bidhan Sarani that regularly picks up awards.

properties.name: Simla Byayam Samity
properties.highlight: Historic puja in Swami Vivekananda's neighbourhood.

properties.name: College Square Sarbojanin
properties.highlight: The lighting reflected on the College Square pond is iconic at night.

properties.name: Santosh Mitra Square (Lebutala)
properties.highlight: Known for giant replica pandals (it once built a gold idol and a chariot), so the queues get long.

properties.name: Sealdah Railway Athletic Club
properties.highlight: Right next to Sealdah station. Easy to add to the Santosh Mitra visit.

properties.name: Ekdalia Evergreen
properties.highlight: A huge traditional idol in a temple-replica pandal. A South Kolkata staple.

properties.name: Singhi Park
properties.highlight: Grand traditional puja just off Gariahat Road.

properties.name: Ballygunge Cultural Association
properties.highlight: Thoughtful art-led themes in a calm-ish setting.

properties.name: Hindustan Park Sarbojanin
properties.highlight: An art-college aesthetic, with fewer crowds than its neighbours.

properties.name: Jodhpur Park
properties.highlight: Big theme pandal in a residential para.

properties.name: Babubagan Sarbojanin
properties.highlight: Neighbourhood puja between Dhakuria and Selimpur.

properties.name: Bosepukur Sitala Mandir
properties.highlight: Famous for intricate material-based pandals.

properties.name: Bosepukur Talbagan
properties.highlight: Bosepukur's other award-winning theme puja.

properties.name: Maddox Square
properties.highlight: Kolkata's favourite adda ground. A traditional idol and the city's best people-watching.

properties.name: Samaj Sebi Sangha
properties.highlight: An elegant puja on Lake View Road with a long cultural legacy.

properties.name: Shib Mandir Sarbojanin
properties.highlight: A compact theme puja near Lake Market.

properties.name: Deshapriya Park
properties.highlight: Once famous for the biggest Durga idol in the world, it now runs grand themes.

properties.name: Tridhara Sammilani
properties.highlight: A South Kolkata showstopper with dazzling theme and light work.

properties.name: 66 Pally
properties.highlight: A Kalighat-side theme puja that often has a social message.

properties.name: Mudiali Club
properties.highlight: Thoughtful themes with an eco slant near Tollygunge.

properties.name: Badamtala Ashar Sangha
properties.highlight: A theme favourite, usually built from unusual materials.

properties.name: Chetla Agrani Club
properties.highlight: Celebrity-studded inaugurations and blockbuster themes across Tolly Nullah.

properties.name: Suruchi Sangha
properties.highlight: New Alipore's showpiece, famous for themes that bring in the art of a different Indian state each year.

properties.name: Behala Notun Dal
properties.highlight: Art-led theme pujas with strong craft work.

properties.name: Behala Friends
properties.highlight: A consistent theme puja near Behala Chowrasta.

properties.name: Behala Sahajatri
properties.highlight: A smaller Behala theme puja with fewer queues.

properties.name: Barisha Club
properties.highlight: Behala's southern anchor, known for detailed themes.

properties.name: FD Block Salt Lake
properties.highlight: Salt Lake's biggest crowd puller, with a grand idol and a full-blown mela.

properties.name: BJ Block Salt Lake
properties.highlight: A spacious theme pandal with an easy walk from Central Park.

properties.name: AE Block Salt Lake
properties.highlight: A relaxed block puja that's good for families.

properties.name: Sreebhumi Sporting Club
properties.highlight: Insta-famous replica pandals and huge gold jewellery on the idol. Lake Town gridlocks for hours.

properties.name: Lake Town Adhibasi Brinda
properties.highlight: A short walk from Sreebhumi, and much calmer.

properties.name: Dum Dum Park Bharat Chakra
properties.highlight: Part of the Dum Dum Park theme row, known for art installations.

properties.name: Dum Dum Park Tarun Sangha
properties.highlight: Theme heavyweight on the Dum Dum Park strip.

properties.name: Dum Dum Park Sarbojanin
properties.highlight: The traditional stop on the Dum Dum Park strip.

properties.name: Bhowanipore 75 Pally
properties.highlight: A Bhowanipore theme puja a short walk from the Jatin Das Park metro.

properties.name: Telengabagan Sarbojanin
properties.highlight: Award-winning theme work off the Belgachia–Ultadanga stretch.

properties.name: Lalabagan Nabankur
properties.highlight: A compact theme puja that fits well between Tala Prattoy and Shyambazar.

properties.name: Rajdanga Naba Uday Sangha
properties.highlight: Kasba's third theme heavyweight, right next to the two Bosepukur pujas.

properties.name: Behala Ajeya Sanghati
properties.highlight: A popular Behala theme puja near Barisha.

properties.name: Mitra Cafe (Sovabazar)
properties.note: A century-old cabin. The kabiraji is the reason you queue.

properties.name: Girish Chandra Dey & Nakur Chandra Nandy
properties.note: Sandesh royalty since 1844. Sells out by evening.

properties.name: Chittaranjan Mistanna Bhandar
properties.note: The Shyambazar sweet stop.

properties.name: Golbari
properties.note: The kosha mangsho at Shyambazar five-point crossing is legendary.

properties.name: Allen's Kitchen
properties.note: Tiny 1900s cabin. Cutlets are fried in pure ghee.

properties.name: Royal Indian Hotel
properties.note: Chitpur's Mughlai institution since 1905.

properties.name: Putiram
properties.note: The College Street breakfast: kochuri and jilipi.

properties.name: Paramount
properties.note: Sherbet parlour since 1918, on the corner of College Square.

properties.name: Indian Coffee House
properties.note: Adda under high ceilings on College Street.

properties.name: Bhim Chandra Nag
properties.note: Home of the ledikeni, a short walk from Santosh Mitra Square.

properties.name: Aminia (New Market)
properties.note: A classic biryani pit stop in the New Market area.

properties.name: Nizam's
properties.note: The kathi roll is said to have been born here.

properties.name: Vivekananda Park Phuchka
properties.note: Often called Kolkata's most famous phuchka. Ask for the tok-jhal-mishti.

properties.name: Lake Market Telebhaja Stalls
properties.note: Late-night fuel between Tridhara and 66 Pally.

properties.name: Balwant Singh's Eating House
properties.note: Bhowanipore's milky tea and dhaba-style tadka.

properties.name: Kewpie's Kitchen
properties.note: A home-style Bengali thali close to Maddox Square.

properties.name: Gariahat Mor Street Food
properties.note: Cheap and quick, right on the Ekdalia–Singhi Park loop.

properties.name: Bhojohori Manna (Ekdalia)
properties.note: A Bengali chain started here. Book ahead during puja.

properties.name: 6 Ballygunge Place
properties.note: An upscale Bengali spread in a heritage house.

properties.name: Arsalan (Park Circus)
properties.note: A biryani heavyweight on the way north from Gariahat.

properties.name: New Alipore Puja Stalls
properties.note: The pop-up food row that grows around Suruchi Sangha.

properties.name: Behala Chowrasta Stalls
properties.note: Street classics at the Behala crossing.

properties.name: City Centre 1 Food Court
properties.note: Air-conditioned toilets and seats, which is gold during pujo.

properties.name: Central Park Mela Stalls
properties.note: Mela food near BJ Block.

properties.name: Lake Town Footbridge Stalls
properties.note: Pop-up stalls along the Sreebhumi queue.

properties.name: Dum Dum Park Puja Stalls
properties.note: Food row between the Dum Dum Park pandals.

properties.name: Bosepukur Puja Food Row
properties.note: Pop-up stalls between the two Bosepukur pandals.

properties.name: Sakherbazar Puja Food Stalls
properties.note: The food row on the Diamond Harbour Road side of Barisha Club.

properties.name: Noapara Metro (Park & Ride)
properties.note: Leave the car here and ride the Blue Line to Shyambazar or Sovabazar.

properties.name: Dum Dum Metro Area (Park & Ride)
properties.note: Ride the metro south, or take an auto to Dum Dum Park.

properties.name: Hatibagan Pay & Park (Bidhan Sarani)
properties.note: Usually closed after 4 pm on the main puja days. Check the KP advisory.

properties.name: Sealdah Station Parking
properties.note: The best car base for Santosh Mitra and Sealdah RAC.

properties.name: New Market Multi-level Parking
properties.note: Walk or take the metro north from Esplanade.

properties.name: Lake Mall (Rashbehari)
properties.note: Right in the Tridhara–Deshapriya–66 Pally cluster. Fills by 6 pm.

properties.name: Forum Mall (Elgin Road)
properties.note: A good base for Maddox Square and Bhowanipore.

properties.name: Quest Mall (Ballygunge Circular Rd)
properties.note: Take a cab or the metro south to the Gariahat cluster.

properties.name: South City Mall
properties.note: The base for Jodhpur Park and Babubagan. A cab to Ekdalia takes about 10 minutes.

properties.name: Behala Bazar Metro (Purple Line)
properties.note: Close to Behala Notun Dal and Sahajatri.

properties.name: New Alipore Police-marked Street Parking
properties.note: Follow the cones. Suruchi Sangha is a 5-minute walk.

properties.name: City Centre 1 Parking
properties.note: Walk to FD Block, or take a short auto to BJ Block.

properties.name: Central Park Salt Lake (Puja Lot)
properties.note: A temporary lot that usually opens on the puja days.

properties.name: Diamond Plaza (Jessore Road)
properties.note: Leave the car here. VIP Road near Sreebhumi stays jammed for hours.
